title: Implement BatchNorm
hint: Implement train/eval BatchNorm: in training, use batch stats over dim=0 and update running_mean/running_var with momentum; in inference, normalize using the running statistics only.

description.text: Implement batch normalization for 2D input (N, D): normalize each feature across the batch (dim=0). In training, use batch statistics and update running_mean/running_var in-place with momentum. In inference, normalize using the running statistics.

examples.output: Normalized using batch mean/var; running buffers updated.
examples.explanation: When training=False, use running_mean and running_var instead of batch stats.

constraints: x is (N, D); gamma, beta, running_mean, running_var shape (D,).
Do not use F.batch_norm or nn.BatchNorm1d.
